messages:
alex: Heads-up — I'm dropping the initial skeleton for a CloudPartnerX marketplace listing and Terraform module set into the repo. Goal: provide a hosted quickstart + VPC/private variant and a concise runbook for partner engineers. Please skim and flag blockers.

tara: Sweet. Is the plan to support both GKE and EKS? We should make the nodepool/autoscaling knobs obvious.

alex: Yes — two infra variants: managed k8s (GKE/EKS) and an all-in-one VM flavor for small partners. Modules planned: `marketplace/listing`, `infra/gke_or_eks`, `deploy/model_service`. Draft snippet for consumers: 
```hcl
module "marketplace_listing" {
  source  = "git::https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-templates.git//modules/listing"
  version = "v0.1.0"
  partner = "cloudpartnerx"
  region  = "us-west-2"
}
```

jordan: We also need an obvious perf smoke-test and expected throughput baseline in the repo (so partner PMs know what to expect). Can we add a perf profile for the Dedicated offering?

priya: @jordan added. Smoke test plan idea: pre-seed a small model, run 100 concurrent requests, assert 99th percentile latency < target (we'll document targets per model size). I'll write a bash script for CI. Also add Console telemetry instructions (token metrics + rollout tags).

marketplace-bot: Heads up: marketplace listing intake window for CloudPartnerX is 2026-04-15. Please plan accordingly. :calendar:

tara: Who's taking ownership of the Terraform security review? I can do an initial pass next Tue.

alex: Owners: tara = security review, priya = smoke tests & CI, jordan = perf profiles, alex = listing metadata + docs. Can we also include a QA checklist: IAM, KMS/CMEK, network egress, data handling note?

priya: I'll add a checklist item: "validate KMS (CMEK) integration + audit log forwarding (Cloud Audit Logs / CloudTrail)".

jordan: For hardware partners we should surface recommended instance families (Ampere/Graviton vs x86) and quantization knobs — add a short file `recommended_instance_types.md`. That helps partners pick cost-efficient SKUs.

alex: Good call. I'll add `recommended_instance_types.md` and a `tfvars` example and a one-click Cloud Shell demo. Also plan to include a minimal Local Dev flow (docker-compose + sample prompts).

tara: Scheduling a short sync with CloudPartnerX engineers — Thu 10am PT. Agenda: modules overview, smoke-test plan, timeline to submit listing. I'll invite CI and security folks.

alex: :thumbsup: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-templates/pull/123 — contains module scaffolding and README stub.

deploy-bot: CI check passed for PR #123 (unit tests + fmt). :white_check_mark:

priya: I'll paste the smoke test script into the PR by EOD tomorrow.

alex: Thanks all — if no major issues after Tara's review we'll ship the partner-facing quickstart and open the intake form for CloudPartnerX.

tara: Noted. I'll post comments on the PR after my review.

jordan: Adding perf profiling task to backlog and sharing a Jupyter notebook example for throughput measurements.

alex: Great — we'll capture open items in the PR and track on the partner JIRA epic.
